pre_condition: self is a PluginStageConfig instance with attributes type (str), replace_cmd (Optional[str]), input_md (Optional[str]), and output_process (Optional[str]).
post_condition: Returns a list of zero or more validation error strings. The returned list is empty if and only if all of the following hold: (1) self.type is one of "pass", "replace", or "modify"; (2) if self.type is "replace", then self.replace_cmd is truthy; (3) if self.type is "modify", then at least one of self.input_md or self.output_process is truthy. When the list is non-empty, each entry is a string identifying which constraint was violated. The function does not modify self or any of its attributes.
